title: Site isolation issue in the CSS Parsing and Computation component
description: A site isolation issue has been identified in the CSS Parsing and Computation component of Microsoft software version 4.0. The vulnerability is catalogued as CVE-2026-74986 and is associated with CWE-200, indicating an information exposure weakness. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and there are no known exploits in the wild. No patch or remediation details are currently available.
